01-idle.note: Soft grey capsule shadow under feet (~57% pet width) reads as a shadow; grey LED is calm-neutral; no chrome.

02-hud-half.note: Half-reveal is the same capsule enlarged with no icons, but its mid-grey fill differs from the near-black full pill.

03-hud-full.note: Pill top edge touches/overlaps the foot pixels; icons natural size with even padding; grey→black fill jump between steps.

04-hud-aim.note: Pill is fully open while the cursor is still out, so the aim prediction is visible; same foot-overlap as 03.

05-working.note: Green LED (2x2 art px) plus flat focused mouth; distinct, but it's the weakest-shaped of the states (no glyph).

06-waiting.note: Amber LED, amber '!' glyph and open mouth give shape plus colour; the '!' adds a held element.

07-stalled.note: Red LED, pink '?', square wide eyes and wavy mouth: unmistakable and distinct from waiting.

08-agents-mixed.note: Amber '!' wins, but the per-agent dots by the antenna are ~1 art px and the red stuck dot is hard to read, so the priority winner is ambiguous.

09-sleeping.note: Closed-line eyes and dark LED; the LED nearly vanishes on dark desktop and the mouth is a single dot.

10-bubble-done.note: One-line neutral 'claude is done' bubble centred on the head with tail at the antenna; mint check separates ready from needs-input.

11-bubble-stalled.note: 'codex needs approval' names the agent and action, but the amber dot/border bubble clashes with the red LED state colour.

12-chat.note: Rounded panel matches the pill fill; empty state states that ~/.claude is read locally; the ~340pt panel is large for the need.

13-chat-convo.note: Top message is clipped mid-glyph ('Anthropic.') and the chip row is cut by the divider; the copy button clears the code.

14-chat-nokey.note: Short keychain-local explainer with a clear 'save' primary, but two stacked input rows and a tall panel.

15-game-anim-on.note: Crown collides with the headphone band and outline at top-left, and the laptop hides the mouth; stays within the silhouette.
